A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Yuuzhan Vong''' tried to sneak a concealed [[villip]] into one of the [[Prophet/Legends|Prophet]] [[Nom Anor|Yu'Shaa's]] [[Jeedai heresy|heresy preachings]]. However, she was caught by [[Kunra]], and Nom Anor, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] behind the mask of Yu'Shaa, ordered the [[Warrior caste|warrior]] to extract the information of whom the villip's partner belonged to before [[Death/Legends|killing]] the female Yuuzhan Vong.
